verdict.rationale: AMD's MI355X page documents expanded MXFP6 and MXFP4 datatype support. The ROCm docs list vLLM and SGLang as supported inference stacks. Community reports show a real Kimi K3 serving deployment on 8×MI355X with measured decode throughput, which confirms a working LLM inference story. Missing for 10: explicit FP8 documentation for this part, MI355X-specific serving recipes (the vLLM/SGLang docs here are only link lists), any llama.cpp support evidence, and independent corroboration beyond one disputed benchmark.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part
